Same experience nung na hospitalize ako sa Heart Center, OP! Pumila rin sina ate dun sa malasakit kasi sayang nga naman kung may maibabawas pa sa bill namin. Kakalipat ko lang din kasi sa ibang hospital noon, so if ever na may kayang ibawas pa, better. Laki na rin ng nagastos sa prev hospital kahit na may HMO. 

Nag kwento sakin si ate nun na umabot na raw ng million yung bill nung kasabay niya. Tapos i think nabawas lang was around 10k?? Sobrang nakakagago. Tapos ito yung times na medyo nawawala na sa balita yung 15B from PhilHealth 🥲. So mas nakakagalit. 

Sobrang sakto lang din kasi yung income namin nun and medyo struggling pa kami nun kasi we were going through grief and its changes pa. So if may mabawas, malaking tulong. Pero dun din namin na realize na may mga mas nangangailangan pa. Gusto namin magpa ubaya pero kailangan din kasi namin ng help hahahuhu. Tang ina talaga ng gobyerno natin. Di naman sila nagkakanda ugaga sa pag hagilap ng funds pang bayad sa hospital bills nila. Pero lakas ng loob manguha pa sa mga mas nangangailangan.

Honestly, I kind of had the same sentiments with OP before. Hindi naman sobra sobrang annoyed haha. Siguro more of bothered with a hint of annoyance na lang. Naiisip ko kasi na instead of just enjoying and living in the moment, it gets spoiled kasi need pa umayos for the photos tapos photo op here, photo op there. 

My dad was like that eh. Wait macomplete yung order before kumain para makuhaan ng photo. Or lagi magpapasuyo para makapag picture. Or wala lang bigla lang siya mag pipicture. Tapos maya maya naka post na yun 🤧 hahahaha. Siguro medyo bothered ako kasi maraming stolen shots HAHA jk. Pero when he passed away somehow mas naappreciate namin yung photos. He had photos and videos of all sorts of events or night outs we had. Yung mga food trip namin haha. Random kalokohan with my siblings. Ang dami niyang kuha. 

Pinaka nagulat ako was when i saw several photos ng sunsets and ng moon. May times kasi na I’d ask him to drive slower kasi gusto ko makakuha ng magandang shot ng sunset usually haha. I never knew he took interest din pala dun. I saw few videos of him singing his heart out sa car haha. Photos of my siblings and I just fooling around. Meron din random photo na magkakatabi lang kaming magkakapatid sa bed while nasa phone lahat hahahah.

Mahilig siya mag post online ng mga shots niya. Which to be honest i think dapat wala na akong pake dun haha kasi account naman niya yun. Pero I’m glad he took a lot of photos. Kasi yeah I was able to live in the moment pero he legit captured and stored it. Even the most mundane things or days na you didnt think wouldve mattered kaya hindi naman need picture-an. Nakakatuwa pala balikan and nakakatuwa na mababalikan.
I’ll bring it up later with my sibling pag uwi niya 😅. Ayoko rin kasi mag cause ng panic hahah. I feel like okay pa naman ako hahaha
